segment.source: Renders a call to action with a row of customer or certification marks underneath, so the ask and the reason to believe it are read in one movement. Use it for: the closing band of a B2B landing page, a signup prompt that needs reassurance, a tender or public-sector page, a page whose visitors have never heard of you. Prefer 'Closing CTA Band' when the logos already live in their own section, and 'Named Contact Panel' when the reassurance is a person rather than a wall of marks.
